expected.canonical_headline: St. Lucie County sends 30-day removal notices to 50-55 license plate camera permit holders
selected_headlines: St. Lucie County finds 14 unpermitted license plate readers during sweep, with more checks ahead
source_headlines: St. Lucie County finds 14 unpermitted license plate readers, says there could be more - WPEC
novel_facts: At least 14 unpermitted/unauthorized cameras discovered during field checks
County does not know who owns the unpermitted cameras
Count rose from 3 cameras on Sept 10 to 14 by Tuesday Sept 15
County posting bright red removal notices directly on unpermitted devices and bagging them
Search for unauthorized cameras not yet complete
County coordinated with Sheriff's Office, Fort Pierce PD, and Port St. Lucie PD
No active applications for new devices under review
Vote was 3-2 (Clasby, Lee, Lowry yes; Fowler, Townsend no)
